verdict.rationale: Zep is a context and memory platform with an API, CLI, and MCP server. Scheduled recurring ingestion or maintenance jobs are a plausible automation feature for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents scheduling, cron-style triggers, or recurring workflows; the only automation shown is one-off API calls such as thread.add_messages and graph.clone.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
